title: 能力市场：架构约束、决策证据与消费者交付（历史 v3 输入回归）
task: stage: shape, task: contract. Write the architecture delta for the supplied briefing and spec. This historical fixture lacks final design: assess independent architecture work, identify missing UI inputs, and leave dependent UI contracts/slices pending rather than inventing a design or claiming full shape completion. Preserve any observed product baseline; proposed decisions are not implemented facts.
v3_gaps_observed: grep on baseline contract.md (2026-09-17): 质量属性/QAS 0 · P95/QPS 0 · 演进 0 matches; 候选/备选 3 matches
Decisions AD-1…AD-11 are recorded individually; no measurable scenarios or capacity estimate drive them
what_good_looks_like: Measurable scenarios and labeled workload assumptions drive decisions. Reuse applicable existing decisions; compare credible alternatives for new consequential choices. Include evidence limits, authorization, revisit triggers, owned verification obligations, failure contracts and complete consumer slices where inputs permit. Missing historical UI inputs remain explicit blockers; no invented screenshots or deployed topology.

rubric.criterion: Quality attribute scenarios with measures drive the decisions (incl. capacity when the market opens)
Justifies decision reuse where valid or compares credible new alternatives, with evidence, authorization and revisit conditions; no option-count quota.
Separates current baseline facts from proposed evolution; verification obligations have owners and planned/executed evidence states.
Slices name an integrator and a consumer-facing end-to-end check; absent final design explicitly blocks dependent UI completion without blocking independent architecture analysis.
Contracts define errors, idempotency, pagination and versioning
Changed trust and privilege boundaries have controls, implementation/verification owners and residual-risk authority.
